beats.summary: Dwight aggressively tries to take back a client from Ryan, causing tension among the staff.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Give me the phone. Tell him Dwight Schrute wants to talk to him.

beats.summary: The sales staff threaten to quit and start their own paper company after losing clients.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: We want our clients back or we quit, Michael.

beats.summary: Michael admits he is in the wrong and apologizes to the sales staff.

evidence.snippet: Michael: No matter how I look at this, I am in the wrong.

beats.summary: Michael returns the clients to the sales staff but rescinds his apology, causing mixed reactions.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Fine, have your clients. I can see that's what you wanted all along. However, I rescind my apology.
